subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 16, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 16, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. Our community has been hard at work, and we're proud to announce several new developments.

Firstly, we're pleased to announce the release of XRAID, a declustered parity RAID for zoned XFS. This new feature is designed to provide improved storage performance and reliability. You can learn more about XRAID in our recent news post.

In addition to XRAID, we've also issued security updates for several packages, including .NET, Firefox, and the Linux kernel. These updates are now available for download and installation.

We're also excited to announce the release of Rust 1.100.0, a major update to the Rust programming language. This new version includes several notable changes, including the stabilization of the thread_local module.

On the development front, we've made several commits to our Calamares configuration files. These updates include improved wayland configs, fixes for shellprocess2 sequence entry, and updated calamares files. We've also added a new package, firefox-fix, which restores window position restore on Linux.

In other news, we've been working on our AcreetionOS GitLab instance, which is now live and available for use. You can find more information about our GitLab instance on our website.

We're also pleased to announce that our Discord server is now live and available for community members to join. This is a great place to connect with other AcreetionOS users, ask questions, and get support.

As always, we're grateful for the hard work and dedication of our community members. Your contributions are what make AcreetionOS possible, and we're excited to see what the future holds for our project.

Finally, we'd like to remind everyone that AcreetionOS is a community-driven project, and we rely on your feedback and suggestions to improve our distribution. If you have any ideas or suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva & Darren Clift
